operational_constraint_measure: Predeclared complexity divergence or task-impossibility quantity
observable_future_object: Held-out intervention-response family or transformation outcome
intervention_or_comparison: Fair nested model comparison under identical Pi A B and horizon
null_or_rival_model: Complete-state ordinary dynamics and redescription R001
required_controls: Same data budget model capacity boundary interventions and target
failure_threshold: No preregistered measurable or formal gain
outcome_if_failed: Treat ICP as a synthesis or heuristic rather than a new principle.

prediction_or_prohibition: Manipulating the proposed physical carrier should alter the future-law family in the specified way.
system_and_scale: Carrier identified at a declared physical scale
operational_constraint_measure: Distance between future-law families before and after carrier manipulation
observable_future_object: Path or outcome distributions under randomized interventions
intervention_or_comparison: Erase replace or perturb M while holding ordinary confounds fixed
required_controls: Material energetic geometric boundary assignment and sham-intervention controls
failure_threshold: Carrier manipulation has no predicted effect within adequate power and measurement sensitivity
outcome_if_failed: Reject or narrow the claimed causal role of that carrier.

prediction_or_prohibition: The proposed ICP equivalence or measure should be stable across declared physically equivalent representations.
system_and_scale: Selected system with a family of justified partitions and coarse-grainings
operational_constraint_measure: Equivalence-class or measure stability with tolerance
observable_future_object: Same operational future-law family expressed in each representation
intervention_or_comparison: Vary factorization observable algebra time resolution and coarse-graining
required_controls: Predeclared equivalence transformations and matched predictive target
failure_threshold: Measure changes arbitrarily while physical predictions remain equivalent
outcome_if_failed: Restrict ICP to an indexed observer/task level or revise the measure.

prediction_or_prohibition: Systems assigned the same M should have the same declared future-law family absent a missing variable.
system_and_scale: Classical or quantum process at declared horizon
operational_constraint_measure: Maximum distance across P^pi(F|M) within an M class
intervention_or_comparison: Prepare distinct histories assigned the same M and randomize identical interventions
required_controls: Matched boundary operation span and adequate sampling
failure_threshold: Systematic out-of-sample inequivalence above preregistered tolerance
outcome_if_failed: M is insufficient; add variables or abandon the equivalence class.

prediction_or_prohibition: A transformation prohibited by a formal ICP version should not occur under the stated resources and tolerance.

outcome_if_failed: Falsify that formal version or its stated scope.

prediction_or_prohibition: A claimed irreducible history effect should survive adequate enlargement of the state or be explicitly restricted to a reduced description.
system_and_scale: Reduced and enlarged descriptions of the same process
operational_constraint_measure: Residual conditional dependence or held-out predictive gain from history
observable_future_object: Future process after a causal break
intervention_or_comparison: Progressively add environment or latent state and compare Markov adequacy
required_controls: Matched interventions resolution regularization and model adequacy tests
failure_threshold: History effect disappears in an empirically sufficient enlarged state
outcome_if_failed: Narrow the claim to representation-dependent memory; do not infer fundamental inheritance.
